common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link for {{appName}}
magicLink.heading: Sign in to {{appName}}
magicLink.body: Use the link below to sign in as {{email}}. It works once.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask to sign in, you can ignore this message. Nothing has changed.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your {{appName}} password
passwordReset.heading: Choose a new password
passwordReset.body: Use the link below to set a new password for {{email}}. It works once.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message. Your password has not changed.

invite.subject: {{inviter}} invited you to {{brandName}} on {{appName}}
invite.heading: You're invited to {{brandName}}
invite.body: {{inviter}} invited {{email}} to join {{brandName}} on {{appName}} as {{role}}. Choose a password and the account is yours.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message. No account exists until you accept.

smtpTest.subject: {{appName}} test message
smtpTest.heading: Your mail server works
smtpTest.body: This message was sent through {{host}} by the Helpdock setup wizard. Receiving it means outgoing email is configured correctly.

outgoingTest.subject: {{brandName}} test message
outgoingTest.heading: Your mail server works
outgoingTest.body: This message was sent through {{host}} from Channels, Outgoing email, in {{brandName}}. Receiving it means replies to customers can go out.

customer.replyMarker: ##- Please type your reply above this line -##
customer.replyHint: Reply to this email to add to your request. Keep the reference in the subject.
customer.autoReplyHint: Reply to this email to add to your request.
customer.autoReplyNote: This is an automatic reply. You receive at most one per request.
customer.footer: You are receiving this because you contacted {{brandName}} support.

acknowledgment.subject: [{{ticket.number}}] We received your message
acknowledgment.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Thanks for writing to {{brand.name}}. Your request is {{ticket.number}} and a member of the {{department.name}} team will reply by email.

To add anything, reply to this email and it joins the same request.

outOfHours.subject: [{{ticket.number}}] We received your message
outOfHours.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Thanks for writing to {{brand.name}}. Your request is {{ticket.number}}. The {{department.name}} team is away right now and will reply by email as soon as they are back.

To add anything, reply to this email and it joins the same request.

subject.sla_warning: [{{reference}}] SLA warning: {{percent}} % of the {{clock}} target used

assigned.rule: A workflow rule assigned it to you.
assigned.skill_based: Skill-based assignment gave it to you.

body.replied: The contact answered on a ticket assigned to you.
body.mentioned: In an internal note on {{subject}}. Customers never see notes.
body.sla_warning: {{percent}} % of the {{clock}} target is used and the ticket still needs an answer.
body.sla_breached: The {{clock}} target has passed and the ticket still needs an answer.
body.escalated: An SLA step or a rule escalated it to you or your team.
